title: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra
scope: Traditional Jyotisha teachings on the ascendant (lagna), signs, planets, houses, and their interpretations.
note: For tropical charts, applying these teachings is a modern adaptation, not a claim that this text prescribed the tropical zodiac.

title: Swiss Ephemeris Programmer's Manual
scope: Technical documentation for astronomical position calculations, sidereal ayanamshas, and house-system computation; not a source for astrological interpretation.
note: This source documents calculation methods only. It does not validate astrology as science or replace traditional interpretive texts.
